topicName: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Entra ID (Azure AD) PIM
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Microsoft Entra ID PIM in Azure"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"This technical tutorial covers how to secure your Azure environment using Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) combined with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management (PIM). By implementing PIM, you enforce just-in-time (JIT) privileged access, reducing the exposure time of vulnerabilities and maintaining strict auditing controls."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Licensing"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Microsoft Azure subscription with appropriate permissions (Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator)."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Microsoft Entra ID P2 licenses for all users who will utilize PIM capabilities."},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Assigning an Eligible Role via Microsoft Entra ID PIM"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Instead of assigning permanent roles, PIM allows you to make users "eligible" for a role. They must activate the role when needed, usually requiring Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and an approval workflow."},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Navigate to the Microsoft Entra admin center, select "Identity governance", and then click on "Privileged Identity Management". Choose "Azure resources" to manage roles scoped to subscriptions, resource groups, or specific resources."},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Automating PIM and RBAC Assignments using PowerShell"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can also manage role assignments programmatically using the Az.Resources PowerShell module. Below is an example script to configure an eligible role assignment for an Azure resource."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"Install-Module -Name Az -Scope CurrentUser -Repository PSGallery -Force
Connect-AzAccount

$roleDefinitionId = (Get-AzRoleDefinition -Name "Contributor").Id
$scope = "/subscriptions/your-subscription-id"
$principalId = "user-object-id-guid"

# Create an eligible assignment (PIM schedule)
New-AzRoleAssignment -ObjectId $principalId -RoleDefinitionId $roleDefinitionId -Scope $scope"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Configuring Role Settings and Activation Policies"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"To enforce security best practices, configure the role settings to require ticket numbers, justification, and approval upon activation. Go to PIM -> Azure resources -> Settings -> Role."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Maximum activation duration: Set to a strict window such as 2 or 4 hours."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Require justification on activation: Enabled to capture the business rationale."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Require Multi-Factor Authentication: Enabled to ensure zero-trust compliance."},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"By integrating Azure RBAC with Microsoft Entra ID PIM, organizations transition from standing administrative privileges to a secure, audited, just-in-time access model. Regularly review PIM audit logs to ensure compliance and identify potential access anomalies."}]
